GL.name: Greenland
GL.note: Outside Schengen. Visa-free if Denmark is visa-free; otherwise a visa specifically endorsed for Greenland is required.

FO.name: Faroe Islands

SJ.name: Svalbard
SJ.note: Visa-free for every nationality under the Svalbard Treaty — but reaching it means transiting mainland Norway, which is Schengen.
